action.instructions: Which single action should the player character take next in this top-down game?

criteria.attack_target: Basic-attack the nearest enemy when it is in range and the player is not in danger.
criteria.skill_on_target: Use the ready skill on the target when several enemies are grouped or the target is worth it.
criteria.kite_back: Move away from enemies to a safer spot when health is low or too many enemies are close.
criteria.drink_potion: Drink a potion when health is low and a potion is ready.
criteria.hold: Do nothing when no enemy is near and no action is useful.

danger.instructions: How much immediate danger is the player in right now?
